core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nimr is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Leopard, panther”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nimr corresponds to the Arabic form نِمْر (Arabic root ن م ر (n-m-r); نِمْر (Nimr)). Its core sense is nimr; leopard, panther. Nimr is Arabic نِمْر (Nimr) 'leopard, panther', from the root ن م ر (n-m-r). The source gloss 'Lion' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: نمر
persian.long_meaning: Nimr (نمر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن نمر، پلنگ است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: निम्र

arabic.name: نِمْر

faq.a: Documented usage records Nimr as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
